# Moonlit Windows

> Moonlit Windows (moonlitwindows.com) sells Night Windows, a series of 75 moonlit landscape pictures, as wall art: $35 posters and $69 black-framed prints (both 12×18 in) and $149 peel-and-stick wall murals (4×6 ft, removable polyester). Shipping is included, everything is printed to order, and checkout is through Stripe. Murals ship in 1–2 weeks. Moonlit Windows is a brand, not a separate company: the shop is owned and operated by Joshua Israel Ventures LLC, which handles every order. Night Windows, Night Shade Art (Instagram @moonnightshadeart) and Prompt Framed are also brands of Joshua Israel Ventures LLC.

## Shop

- [Home](https://moonlitwindows.com/): Gallery of all 75 Night Windows pieces with prices and links to each piece page
- [Shop posters, prints & wall murals](https://moonlitwindows.com/buy.html): Every piece with poster ($35), framed ($69) and wall mural ($149) checkout buttons
- [Mountain wall art](https://moonlitwindows.com/mountain-wall-art.html): 16 moonlit mountain pieces (Matterhorn, Dolomites, Mount Fuji, Yosemite, Isle of Skye, the Great Wall and more) with a room guide and FAQ
- [Peel and stick wall murals](https://moonlitwindows.com/peel-and-stick-wall-murals.html): 39 moonlit scenes picked for a feature wall as 4×6 ft (48×72 in) removable peel-and-stick wall murals ($149, shipping included), with measuring, wall prep and FAQ
- [Lake and waterfall wall art](https://moonlitwindows.com/lake-wall-art.html): 19 moonlit lake and waterfall posters ($35), framed prints ($69) and wall murals ($149), from Lake Como, Lake Bled, Hallstatt and Lake Louise to Plitvice, Iguazu and Victoria Falls, with a room guide and FAQ
- [Coastal wall art](https://moonlitwindows.com/coastal-wall-art.html): 14 moonlit ocean, seaside and fjord posters ($35), framed prints ($69) and wall murals ($149), from the Amalfi Coast, Santorini and Cinque Terre to the Cliffs of Moher, Big Sur and Lofoten, with a room guide and FAQ
- [Asian wall art](https://moonlitwindows.com/asian-wall-art.html): 12 moonlit Japanese, Chinese and temple posters ($35), framed prints ($69) and wall murals ($149), from Mount Fuji, Kyoto and the Great Wall to the Taj Mahal, Angkor Wat and Bagan, with a room guide and FAQ
- [European wall art](https://moonlitwindows.com/european-wall-art.html): 14 moonlit castle, old town and village posters ($35), framed prints ($69) and wall murals ($149), from Neuschwanstein, Venice and Prague to Bruges, Dubrovnik, Provence and Tuscany, with a room guide and FAQ
- [The Night Windows series](https://moonlitwindows.com/night-windows.html): Overview of the series and an index of all 75 pieces

## Representative pieces

- [Matterhorn Alpine Moon](https://moonlitwindows.com/pieces/matterhorn-alpine-moon.html): The Matterhorn over a still alpine lake under moonlight; poster, framed print or wall mural
- [Mount Fuji Pagoda Moon](https://moonlitwindows.com/pieces/mount-fuji-pagoda-moon.html): The Chureito Pagoda among cherry blossoms with Mount Fuji under a full moon
- [Isle of Skye Storr Moon](https://moonlitwindows.com/pieces/isle-of-skye-storr-moon.html): The Old Man of Storr above Skye's slopes and lochans under a Highland moon
- [Meteora Monasteries Moon](https://moonlitwindows.com/pieces/meteora-monasteries-moon.html): Meteora's monasteries on stone pillars with mist in the valley and a rising moon
- [Santorini Caldera Moon](https://moonlitwindows.com/pieces/santorini-caldera-moon.html): Whitewashed terraces and blue domes above a moonlit caldera
- [Northern Lights Fjord](https://moonlitwindows.com/pieces/northern-lights-fjord.html): Aurora above a quiet fjord framed by snowy mountains
- [Lakeside Cabin](https://moonlitwindows.com/pieces/lakeside-cabin.html): A warm cabin beside a quiet lake with a moon reflection and dark pines
